subject: Debit note for INV-2526-01305
body:
Dear Horizon Logistics & Co team,

We have reviewed invoice INV-2526-01305 dated 10 Sep 2025 and found that IGST was applied though the party is in the same state (state code 7). The supply should carry CGST and SGST. We are issuing a debit note for Rs 3,219 and will send a corrected invoice. Please adjust your records.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
